note: am 和 I 连用，例如 I am happy.（我很开心。）
imageHint: a happy child pointing to themselves

note: is 常和 he、she、it 或单个人、物连用，例如 He is a student.（他是一名学生。）
imageHint: one student standing with a school bag

meaning: 是（和 you 或复数连用）
note: are 常和 you、we、they 连用，例如 We are friends.（我们是朋友。）
imageHint: a group of children standing together as friends

note: isn't 是 is not 的缩写，例如 It isn't a dog.（它不是一只狗。）
imageHint: a cat beside a crossed out picture of a dog

note: aren't 是 are not 的缩写，例如 They aren't teachers.（他们不是老师。）
imageHint: two young students holding school bags
a child crying with tears on their cheeks
an adult driving a car with a seat belt on

note: funny 表示有趣、让人发笑。
imageHint: a child making a funny face

note: hope 表示希望一件好事发生。
imageHint: a child hoping for a sunny day while looking out a window
children laughing together at a funny story

note: nice 可以形容人友好，也可以表示很好。
imageHint: a friendly child helping another child pick up books
a child with a warm smile
a strong child showing arm muscles
a student reading a book at a classroom desk

note: young 表示年轻的、年纪小的。
imageHint: a young child playing in a park
